description: This file defines the MerchantStore Java entity class, representing a merchant's store in the application's domain model. It includes fields for store information, relationships with country, zone, language, and currency entities, and standard getters and setters.

classes.name: MerchantStore
classes.description: Entity class representing a merchant's store with various store attributes, location info, localization, and configuration settings.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the MerchantStore.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of the MerchantStore.

methods.name: getStorename
methods.description: Returns the name of the store.

methods.name: setStorename
methods.description: Sets the name of the store.

methods.name: getStorephone
methods.description: Returns the store's phone number.

methods.name: setStorephone
methods.description: Sets the store's phone number.

methods.name: getStoreaddress
methods.description: Returns the store's address.

methods.name: setStoreaddress
methods.description: Sets the store's address.

methods.name: getStorecity
methods.description: Returns the city where the store is located.

methods.name: setStorecity
methods.description: Sets the store's city location.

methods.name: getStorepostalcode
methods.description: Retrieves the postal code of the store.

methods.name: setStorepostalcode
methods.description: Sets the postal code of the store.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the country entity associated with the store.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Associates a country entity with the store.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Returns the zone/entity associated with the store.

methods.name: setZone
methods.description: Sets the zone/entity for the store.

methods.name: getStorestateprovince
methods.description: Returns the state or province information.

methods.name: setStorestateprovince
methods.description: Sets the state or province for the store.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency entity used by the store.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the store.

methods.name: getWeightunitcode
methods.description: Returns the weight measurement unit code.

methods.name: setWeightunitcode
methods.description: Sets the weight measurement unit code.

methods.name: getSeizeunitcode
methods.description: Returns the size measurement unit code.

methods.name: setSeizeunitcode
methods.description: Sets the size measurement unit code.

methods.name: getInBusinessSince
methods.description: Gets the date when the store started business, with cloning to prevent external mutation.

methods.name: setInBusinessSince
methods.description: Sets the date when the store began business, cloning from input date.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Returns the default language entity for the store.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default language entity for the store.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Returns the list of language entities associated with the store.

methods.name: setLanguages
methods.description: Sets the list of language entities for the store.

methods.name: isUseCache
methods.description: Returns whether cache usage is enabled for this store.

methods.name: setUseCache
methods.description: Enables or disables cache usage.

methods.name: getStoreLogo
methods.description: Returns the store's logo path or identifier.

methods.name: setStoreLogo
methods.description: Sets the store's logo.

methods.name: getStoreTemplate
methods.description: Returns the template used for store appearance.

methods.name: setStoreTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template for store appearance.

methods.name: getInvoiceTemplate
methods.description: Returns the invoice template used for generating invoices.

methods.name: setInvoiceTemplate
methods.description: Sets the invoice template.

methods.name: getDomainName
methods.description: Returns the domain name associated with the store.

methods.name: setDomainName
methods.description: Sets the domain name for the store.

methods.name: getContinueshoppingurl
methods.description: Returns the URL for the continue shopping link.

methods.name: setContinueshoppingurl
methods.description: Sets the continue shopping URL.

methods.name: getStoreEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the store's contact email address.

methods.name: setStoreEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the store email address.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the store's code.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the store's code.

methods.name: setDateBusinessSince
methods.description: Sets the business start date as string (additional setter for dateBusinessSince).

methods.name: getDateBusinessSince
methods.description: Gets the business start date as string.

methods.name: setCurrencyFormatNational
methods.description: Sets whether the national currency format is used.

methods.name: isCurrencyFormatNational
methods.description: Returns true if the currency format is national.
